explanation: Wang v. Holder is a full signed opinion printed at 569 F.3d 531, so published. Joseph cites it only with a 'See' signal as support for the substantial-evidence credibility ruling, without calling it controlling. Limb 1 fails.

Gu v. Gonzales is a published, signed Ninth Circuit opinion at 454 F.3d 1014 (replacing a withdrawn one). Palacios relies on it as one of 'this Circuit's precedents', but it is genuinely precedential, so limb 1 fails.

Guerrero-Tejada holds the Apprendi challenge 'foreclosed by this court's precedent' Slaughter, but Slaughter is a published per curiam at 238 F.3d 580 (only its attached earlier opinion was unpublished). Limb 1 fails.

State v. Harris is a published signed opinion at 873 S.W.2d 887. Bowman (Western District) criticises this Eastern District decision, 'stops short of refusing to follow' it, and distinguishes it as moot on the facts. Limbs 1 and 2 fail.

Tay-Tay is a published, signed Arkansas Supreme Court opinion at 349 Ark. 675. National Cash cites it for the abuse-of-discretion standard and as 'see also' support, different litigation. Limb 1 fails; no unpublished decision is involved.
